Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't worry, little fella. It's just your annual vet visit. Plus the harmonica music's probably not helping.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, you don't usually come to these vet appointments.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you mean? He's a member of our family. Of course, I'm concerned with his health stuff. Oh, look! There's a Slushy Dawg! Gotta go! Bye! (unbuckles and gets out of the car) Jeremy, Jeremy, Jeremy, Jeremy, Jeremy, car! (stops to cross the road) Jeremy, Jeremy, Jeremy, Jeremy!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Jeremy's working there today.

Name: Linda
Dialog: That tracks.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa, this place is packed!

Name: Veterinarian
Dialog: This Chippin' Day brought in way too many people! We're swamped!

Name: Pet owner 1
Dialog: When can we see the doctor? My Renaldo has waiting room anxiety.

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: Oh, my gosh, your leg!

Name: Pet owner 1
Dialog: Oh, that's just his denim scratching post.

Name: Pet owner 2
Dialog: Hercules' appointment was an hour ago. We're gonna be late for the groomers.

Name: Pet owner 3
Dialog: Me, too!

Name: Pet owners 4 and 5
Dialog: Us, too!

Name: Pet owner 3
Dialog: Them, too!

Name: Pet owner 6
Dialog: My Petunia's just fine waiting. But Petunia II wants her free chipping, and she wants it now!

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: I'm so sorry, folks, but if you'll be patient, the vet will see everyone as quickly as she can.

Name: Pet owner 7
Dialog: That's not good enough!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: If only these people had something to do while they wait.

Name: Pet owner 1
Dialog: Oh, Renaldo, I know brushing soothes you. I'm so sorry Daddy forgot your brush!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hmm, I'm formulating a plan. I know what we're gonna do to—Oh, you're way ahead of me, Ferb. We'll build the ultimate while-you-wait pet wash and grooming machine! I'll call the gang.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: And for once, we know exactly where Perry is.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Hello, Agent P. We were concerned because we tracked you to the Slushy Dawg. I mean, do you know how much sodium is in their hot dogs? (gags) But by the third bite, you're committed. Now we see you're at the vet across the street, which is even more concerning. Agent P, you cannot be chipped or your host family could track you at all times.

Name: Carl
Dialog: So could your enemies!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Carl, are you familiar with the phrase, "No duh"? (to Agent P) Getting chipped could put the entire operation in danger, so avoid it by any means necessary. But it's, uh... it's always good to have a checkup.

Name: Carl
Dialog: It is flea and tick season.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Yes. Yes, it is, Carl. (He scratches his head with his foot.)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, why do I do this to myself? I'm not even thinking about hot dogs and I just walked by this place and it's like I lose all control. (takes a bite) Ich! But by the third bite, you're committed. Wait, is that—Is that Perry the Platypus? Well, he is an animal. Maybe he's got worms or something. He should watch what he eats. Hmmm. What is he doing? Look at him over there, protagonizing. Now I have to go over there and antagonize! Eugh! Oh, one more bite. (He stuffs the entire dog into his mouth.) Oh, I hate myself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow! Nobody puts condiments on dogs like you do.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That might be why they made me assistant junior manager. Just got promoted.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, so you're conditionally in charge?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Well, only on weekends before 11

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Candace, I love that you came to visit, but rules are rules.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Paying customers only." Fine. (breaks out her cash) One Slushy fries, handsome.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: There's also that sign.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "No flirting with employees." Is it that big of a problem?

Name: Buford
Dialog: One chili dog. And yer shirt color really suits your eyes.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: You've already been warned, Buford.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (gasps) Oh! (gasps)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: (screaming) Mmm!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Whoa!

Name: Pet owners
Dialog: Yay!

Name: Veterinarian
Dialog: Thank goodness. The main office is sending over a temporary vet to help. Give him this chipping gun and send him to exam room 1 when he gets here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, he-he-hello. Have you seen a platypus around here? About yea high, very trappable.

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: Oh, you're the doctor?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, I'm—Yes, I am! I am a doctor! Thank you. Thank you. A lot of people just stampede straight to "pharmacist" for some reason. I don't know why.

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: Great. Here's the chipping gun. Follow me.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: A chipping gun? L-L-L-Like a tracking chip? Wait a minute, just so I understand this correctly, this is an apparatus that will plant a tracking chip into an animal, allowing anyone to know where they are at all times?

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: Mm-hmm.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I could put a chip... in my goat!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, wait! Even better. My goldfish!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (gasps) Or even better than that, I can chip Perry the Platypus! Haha! This is amazing! This is, uh, like a platypus-find-inator that I didn't even have to think of or build! It's, it's like getting a freebie! Man, I need to hit Slushy Dawg more often. Sorry, thighs.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now all I need is to find Perry the Platypus.

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: (takes Doof's wrist) Right this way, Doctor. In here, you'll find a platypus.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Really? Oh, this is too easy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aha! Oh, wait. You're, you're just a regular platypus. I'm sorry. You're completely useless to me. No offense.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Now, which Roomy the Roomypus would Perry the Platypus be in?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Then you seriously underestimated us.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (singsongy) Perry the Platypus? Where are you?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aha! Perry the Platypus!

Name: Phil
Dialog: No, uh, Phil the accountant. Doctor, about Hazel's eczema...

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh! Heh heh. Whoops! Uh, I'm just gonna "eczema" this room.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, no, I didn't know you were so sick. Stay with me!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Wait, you're not Perry the Platypus!

Name: Beaver owner
Dialog: That's Felix, my beaver. He likes to hide under a blankie.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, I think I'm just gonna eczema this room, too.

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: Doctor, you're supposed to be in exam room 1 with the platypus.

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: I'm actually not familiar with this species. Mind if I stay and observe?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Well, I guess I could warm up with this platypus. (He sticks the gun into Perry.) Here you go. (Perry gets away.) Hey, no—Hold still!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold still! Hold still—Argh! (he shoots the gun at the platypus, but misses) It's a good thing I have this practice platypus, 'cause this is much harder than I thought.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yow! Brain freeze! (groans, sighs) So anyway, as I was saying, how nice is this to be taking a little break—

Name: Slushy Dawg Manager
Dialog: (clears throat)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, man. (takes out more cash) Okay, okay, paying customer here. (suppressed burp, to Jeremy) Hit me with another chili dog, but hold the onions. Anyway, as I was saying, how nice to be taking a break?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb?!?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Linda
Dialog: How's it going?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, Jeremy got all his shots and Perry got promoted. But you gotta come back to see what the boys are doing!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Fine, I'll see you soon.

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Even Perry the Platypus isn't this difficult.

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: (leaves) Maybe he's nervous because I'm here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sighs) Oh, yeah. Good. I don't think I can keep up this vet thing for—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus?! How did you get in here?! Oh, never mind. Ha ha! Behold! Well, it started as a chipping gun, but now it's my platypus-finder-inator! You missed the... the whole rebranding process.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Trying to chip me? How original! My idea! Copycat! Copycat!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hey, Perry the Platypus, you want some fish with those chips? Ha ha!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aah!

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: Eh, I'm starting to think that's not the temp vet.

Name: Veterinarian
Dialog: Yeah? Then where is he?

Name: Temp Vet
Dialog: And now I'm committed.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! Ow! Ow!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You are chipped now, baby!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aah!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Hurry!

Name: Linda
Dialog: A sun shower, how lovely!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, look, Candace, a rainbow!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But but but but...

Name: Receptionist
Dialog: Thanks for your help, kids. It got a little crazy there for a while.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Our pleasure.

Name: Veterinarian
Dialog: I'm happy to report that Perry has a clean bill of health. Oh, I almost forgot, it's free chipping today. Would you like to have him chipped?

Name: Perry
Dialog: (nervous chatter)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Nah, he's a platypus. They don't do much.

Name: Perry
Dialog: Phew!

Name: Veterinarian
Dialog: Funny. It senses one of you has been chipped.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: That's me. From that time I went feral.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: (screams like the goat)
